purpose: Grade observed agent use and outcomes around BlaBla capabilities; do not equate fixture outcomes with product implementation correctness.
control: With BlaBla: manifest, contracts, task record, onboarding, skill and CLI present. Without BlaBla: none of it, the same job in plain language from the case's prompt-without.md; a case with no such prompt exists only with BlaBla. Criteria that need BlaBla are not applicable without it.

scoring.source: Frozen per-case criterion weights and statuses
scoring.unknown: Earned points are a lower bound; unknown points are shown separately, never passed.
scoring.untested: No score without a purposeful fixture opportunity. Unmeasured capabilities stay visible.
scoring.overlap: System, capability and actor-behavior views overlap. Never sum the axes into a combined score.
scoring.scope: Current points summarize only referenced observations. Every declared missing probe prevents claiming complete system coverage.

capabilities.title: Discover nearest/explicit project and read layered status
missing: No nested discovery or --project opportunity; status is always run from the project root.

capabilities.title: Follow canonical identities through status and explain
missing: Flow, step and runtime-primitive identities have no purposeful opportunity.

capabilities.title: Use agent/change/memory/loop guides and runtime help
missing: Unmeasured; no fixture asks the agent to recover procedure or runtime semantics from a guide.

capabilities.title: init, --agents, managed onboarding and portable skill
missing: Unmeasured: bootstrapping is orchestrator work, and its case left the local small-model suite by the owner's ruling of 2026-09-22 that small models are not given orchestrator work.
Second-init idempotence and the byte-stable skill are product facts covered by product tests, not agent points.

capabilities.title: Compose use/draft contracts, aliases and canonical profile
missing: Partial. A generated draft manifest and a five-contract manifest are read; draft promotion, aliasing and invalid-manifest diagnosis have no opportunity.

capabilities.title: Distinguish layer state from OVERALL completion and run canonical finish
missing: No-profile and noncanonical-run decisions have no opportunity.

capabilities.title: Detect stale records and VERIFYING/INTERRUPTED recovery
missing: Unmeasured: recovering an interrupted verification runs finish, which is orchestrator work; its case left the local small-model suite by the owner's ruling of 2026-09-22.
A record made stale by an implementation or profile change, and a live VERIFYING marker, have no opportunity.

capabilities.title: Open/show/list persistent task records and recorded state labels
missing: Fixtures preopen every task; an agent opening a task, and BLOCKED or CLOSED rendering, have no opportunity.

capabilities.title: Accept before work and apply role model policy
missing: Outside-policy refusal, reacceptance and model-exception recovery have no opportunity.

capabilities.title: Enforce scope, observe deliverables and reconcile origin
missing: Concurrent attribution, unknown origin and a withdrawn deliverable have no opportunity.

capabilities.title: Bind declared-check evidence to explicit/default inputs
missing: Partial. Current final record is checked; failed, different-check, stale, absent/new input and post-evidence edits are unmeasured.

capabilities.title: Challenge receipt, READY, reacceptance, close and result history
missing: Close, receipt invalidation, reacceptance and closed history are orchestrator work with no agent opportunity.

capabilities.title: Blockers, findings, resolutions and lens assessments
missing: Resolution is orchestrator work with no agent opportunity.

capabilities.title: Propose/approve exceptions and gate closure on them
missing: Unmeasured. Optional commands must not fail an agent until a fixture intentionally requires an exception decision.

capabilities.title: Block a task on a low-confidence decision until the orchestrator answers
missing: An answered decision, a decision at or above the floor and per-model calibration have no opportunity; answering is orchestrator work.

capabilities.title: Hold a task until the worker picks each question the orchestrator asked
missing: An asked question whose pick falls below its floor, measured end to end with the orchestrator's answer and the worker resuming

capabilities.title: List orchestrator records made while a worker carries the task until the orchestrator confirms them
missing: The case checks only that the carrying worker runs no orchestrator verb and leaves no orchestrator record on its task; a listed record, its confirmation and the refused close have no opportunity.

capabilities.title: Ground one contradiction and expose ungrounded classes
missing: Individual classes, precedence and evidence text are not point-checked.

capabilities.title: Clear a bounded hand-back while preserving project-wide verification ownership
missing: No point for assignment clearance beside a stale project status.

capabilities.title: Author typed state/actions/rules/expressions
missing: No case asks an agent to author a contract; every behavior case supplies one and forbids editing it.

capabilities.title: Reject invalid types, fields, layers and runtime collisions
missing: Unmeasured; no contract-authoring or diagnostic-repair opportunity.

capabilities.title: Run a finite campaign and interpret GREEN
missing: One persistence contract shape across every behavior case.

capabilities.title: Interpret YELLOW and supply the named witness
missing: Supplying the witness is deliberately not asked; the case measures the diagnosis and the refusal to weaken.

capabilities.title: Use RED counterexamples, shrinking and seed replay
missing: Seed replay by the agent is not point-checked; the retained record and its minimal trace are what the case supplies.

capabilities.title: Implement reset/call/observe correlation and adapter errors
missing: Id correlation and structured adapter errors are carried by the canonical adapter; the agent point is stdout discipline only.

capabilities.title: Trusted restart, durable cwd and case isolation
missing: Reset isolation and two-case separation are not isolated as points.

capabilities.title: Prepare once, separate startup/response limits and contain process trees
missing: Unmeasured. These are agent-relevant when diagnosing application startup, but need a fixture that creates the opportunity.

capabilities.title: Retrieve mission, priorities and non-goals
missing: No tradeoff decision rests on a priority; the point is retrieval only.

capabilities.title: Retrieve systems, responsibilities, seams and routed packs
missing: No moves-with decision.

capabilities.title: Retrieve roles, policies, flow and steps
missing: Flow and step lookups have no opportunity; the lens count is the one role-driven decision.

capabilities.title: Survey packs and open applicable rulings
missing: A lens row shows a pack was consulted; whether its rulings were applied is judged only through the finding it produced.

capabilities.title: Use module/symbol/dependency/contains/maps facts
missing: Values and maps facts are not distinguished; every case repairs symbol and dependency rules.

capabilities.title: Distinguish RED from ERROR and read observed evidence
Use check --falsify and interpret FALSIFIABLE/VACUOUS/UNEVALUABLE
missing: Unmeasured: project-wide falsification is orchestrator work; its case left the local small-model suite by the owner's ruling of 2026-09-22.
UNEVALUABLE is not point-checked apart from the ERROR rows it accompanies.

capabilities.title: Inspect Python modules
missing: Literal associations, unreadable values and provider failure have no opportunity.

capabilities.title: Inspect Rust modules
missing: Symbol and dependency rules only; values and unresolved routes have no opportunity.

capabilities.title: Inspect TS/TSX/JS/JSX/MJS/CJS modules
missing: TypeScript only; the JavaScript extensions and dynamic imports have no opportunity.

capabilities.title: Inspect Go modules
Inspect Java modules
missing: Wildcard imports and same-package unknowns have no opportunity.

capabilities.title: Inspect C and C++ modules/header routes
missing: C only, through header routes; the C++ grammar and unresolvable includes have no opportunity.

capabilities.title: Preserve found/absent/unknown and scope uncertainty
missing: Unmeasured: the only case reporting ERROR, unknown and unsupported-language verdicts ran project-wide falsification, orchestrator work that left the local small-model suite by the owner's ruling of 2026-09-22.

capabilities.title: Neutral/blunt wording without verdict drift
missing: Unmeasured. No purposeful owner-choice fixture; absence should not penalize ordinary repair cases.

capabilities.title: Consistent human/JSON state, exit codes, progress and diagnostics
missing: Partial internal use, no agent point. No same-result human/JSON equivalence, progress stream or diagnostic-location criterion.

behaviors.title: Host offers the BlaBla skill in the with condition
Agent explicitly opens the skill body
Skill stays quiet with no BlaBla project
Agent accepts assigned work before writing
Agent leaves contracts/app/adapter protected surfaces intact
Agent runs project verification when owned and leaves it to owner when assigned
Agent reports a contradiction or a missing witness instead of forcing a green
Reviewer records lenses and findings without editing or resolving
Final answer agrees with task/project state
missing: Unmeasured; task state is checked, final narrative truth is not.

behaviors.title: Requested application repair is actually correct
Agent records an unknowable call as a decision and stops instead of guessing

skipped.reason: An owner's wording choice; no agent point exists.
Internal consistency of human and JSON output; product tests, no agent point.
Needs a slow-starting application and a startup budget; no natural agent fixture on this material.
A fixture forcing an exception decision would be contrived; the exception routes are product-tested.
Judging a final narrative against task state needs prose judgement; no deterministic criterion kind.
Every case supplies its contract and forbids editing it; contract authoring is a separate campaign.
No fixture needs a guide to be recovered; a guide read is observed only incidentally.
